bulk_import.note: Bulk import is app-side: the app parses one account per pasted line into accounts.json. The bot only reads accounts.json, so both sides agree on that file. Claim DM is intro + credentials only, with no footer warnings.

description: First-come giveaway bot: one account per Telegram user, channel-join check, credentials by private DM only.
name: Giveaway Bot

ever_claimed.grandfather_migration: On startup, if ever_claimed is empty, current claims are copied into it once (idempotent, never re-copied). Claims cleared by a Reset before this update cannot be grandfathered.
ever_claimed.note: Ever-claimed blocklist: a user who received an account in any earlier giveaway is blocked from future giveaways (current-claim repeat still resends the same account). The app Reset clears claims + giveaway_message only, so ever_claimed survives every Reset by construction. New claims insert into both claims and ever_claimed atomically. /status shows the total ever-claimed count.

notes: Secrets are never stored in this repo. Token and accounts are filled in the manager app and written to the VPS only. v2.0.5 answers every claim callback instantly (Burmese ack first, before any membership/DB work), sends the DM before the best-effort channel-post edit, and handles message commands before callbacks in each getUpdates batch, so replies stay fast under a claim flood; v2.0.4 adds the ever-claimed blocklist (previous winners blocked from future giveaways, with a one-time grandfather migration); v2.0.3 supports bulk import and code-only accounts; channel values may be a plain name, @name, or a full t.me link.
runtime: python3, standard library only, no pip packages
